lines.text: If you're concerned about your child's health or development, talk to a GP or health visitor, or speak to a nurse, doctor or special educational needs co-ordinator (SENCO) at your child's school.
They may refer your child to an occupational therapist, paediatrician, or another health professional who can assess them and try to identify any developmental problems.
Find out more about diagnosing DCD in children.
